# `aitbc analytics predict`

Predict future chain performance for a single chain or all chains.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc analytics predict [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Specific chain ID for predictions |
| `--hours` | integer | `24` | no | Prediction time horizon in hours |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc analytics predict
```
